notes.title: Patch 3 + FREE CLOCKO SKIN!
notes.content:
[h1]PATCH 3[/h1]
[b]New day, new bug fixes. Check it all out here plus a new addition to the game.[/b]
There was an issue relating to equipping skins for Clocko which has now been fixed. To compensate, all RadioWave players will now have a free skin: Blue Moon Clocko. This will be free FOREVER!
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1107102481495904397/1349634018143899708/Screenshot_2025-03-13_171513.png?ex=67d3d020&is=67d27ea0&hm=32f99d65d6f58281b3f20318a8c494b21b88052352bc33479687692d9378dfe8&=&format=webp&quality=lossless[/img]
[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2]
Besides that, we also have a variety of fixes:
[list]
[*] Shader issue has finally been definitely fixed.
[*] Changed a few wall detail maps
[*] Fixed Clocko's skin equipping
[*] Custom Mode occlusion culling has been rebuilt.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Shader issue has finally been definitely fixed.
[*] Custom Mode occlusion culling has been rebuilt.

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.content:
Another day, another patch! This should hopefully be the last patch before work on the next Chapter of the Campaign!
[list]
[*] Fixed Ranking system in Custom Mode, Custom Players will now be able to get the 2000 achievement again!
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Fixed Ranking system in Custom Mode, Custom Players will now be able to get the 2000 achievement again!

notes.title: Day 1 Patch
notes.content:
Some fixes and patches have been deployed! Thank you for being apart of RadioWave and reporting these bugs!

[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Occlusion Culling has been added to the main menu.
[*] Shader errors have been fixed.
[*] Lowered Graphics to make the game easier to load up.
[/list]

tags.feature: Occlusion Culling has been added to the main menu.

tags.balance_change: Lowered Graphics to make the game easier to load up.

notes.title: RadioWave has launched!
notes.content:
RadioWave is now out on Steam for all to play, enjoy and be scared of!
The definitive mascot experience now has 3 modes, with many more stuff planned in the future of the game's life cycle.
[b]Including:[/b]
[list]
[*] Multiplayer
[*] Campaign
[*] Custom Mode
[/list]

Have fun surviving the RadioWave! ːsteammockingː
